fixes.explanation: Mama's not in this conversation, friend. Jacob tells Rachel and Leah that their father's attitude toward him has changed, and then he says, “…the God of my father has been with me.” (Genesis 31:5) Rebekah is Jacob's mother (Genesis 28:5), but the One he names out in that field is God. That credit goes to Him.

Nice try, friend, but no gifts show up in this dream. The angel says, “for I have seen all that Laban has done to you.” (Genesis 31:12) His eyes are on what Laban did, not on anything Jacob handed over. Jacob hears that nothing Laban did got missed.

problems.problem: Jacob does not lead with God’s presence. He first tells Rachel and Leah that their father’s attitude toward him has changed.
